text: Do not call a library sort function: `std::sort`, `std::stable_sort`, `std::partial_sort`, `std::nth_element`, `std::ranges::sort`, `qsort`.

Sort with an insertion sort you wrote yourself: take the elements one by one and insert each into its place in the already-sorted prefix (iterative or recursive). Any other algorithm (a library sort, selection sort, bubble sort, merge sort) does not satisfy this constraint, whatever the function is called.
